prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def segments(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i]+1 < bounds[i+1]]
    rsegs, csegs = segments(h, sep_rows), segments(w, sep_cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rsegs:
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in csegs:
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            base = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            n_other = sum(v != base for v in vals)
            row_out.append(1 if n_other == 2 else base)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
